title: Greek I: Foundations of New Testament Greek
description: An introduction to the Koine Greek of the New Testament. Students learn the alphabet and pronunciation, nouns and the case system, the article, adjectives, pronouns, prepositions, and the present, future and imperfect indicative. Every lesson includes parsing drills drawn from real words in the Greek New Testament (STEPBible's TAGNT), checked against STEPBible's morphology tags, and the tutor uses the STEPBible data to show each form in its biblical context. By the end students can read simple New Testament sentences such as John 1:1-5.
